note: Spec 68 §7.5 rule 7a; Spec 69 M-54 dated note 2026-10-07 (operator ruling) and M-60. An absence ruling makes a target `unregulated` BY ABSENCE for a zone only when no unit of any by-law layer exists for that target on the lot (keyed or pending) and the lot's exception and every exception it INCLUDEs is authored for the target (else not_evaluated:exception_not_authored). Provincial units never switch it off (they only restrain a by-law value). The result carries evidence kind `absence`, never a clause, and is flagged for the M-29 expert sample. Every entry is executed against its pinned page by evaluate.mjs checkAbsenceRulings() (bylaw-harden tests, no id filter): case-insensitive and whitespace-folded; every occurrence of every occurrence pattern must lie inside a declared accounted occurrence, so a new clause naming the target fails; absent phrases never occur; present phrases occur.
